name: Baby Blue
bio: Archetype: Mental DEF Debuff, Crowd Control. ⌽ Inflicts various debuffs including ST Mental DEF down, [Nightmare] and AoE DMG Taken up. ⌽ Applies defensive effects like enemy DMG Dealt down, ally DMG Taken down and ally Crit DEF up. ⌽ Insight helps her tank Mental DMG, useless against Reality DMG.
